fields.title: Property Consultant
fields.short_description: Buyer aur Seller ke beech trusted broker. Sirf 2% commission pe apni dream property paaein.
fields.long_description: Hum aapko best properties dikhate hain — residential, commercial aur plots. Humara builder network bahut strong hai. Hum sirf 2% commission lete hain deal close hone par. Buyer aur Seller dono ki needs hum samajhte hain.

fields.title: Interior Design
fields.short_description: Aapke ghar ya office ko beautiful aur functional banate hain. Budget mein best design.
fields.long_description: Hum residential aur commercial interior design karte hain. Kitchen, bedroom, living room, office — sab kuch. 3D design, material selection aur execution sab included hai. Aapka budget aur taste dono ka khayal rakhte hain.

fields.title: Digital Marketing
fields.short_description: Aapke business ki online presence badhate hain. Social media, SEO aur paid ads.
fields.long_description: Hum aapke business ko online grow karne mein help karte hain. Social media management, SEO, Google Ads, Facebook Ads — sab kuch. Monthly reports aur transparent results. Aapka business badhega, guaranteed.

fields.title: Referral Program
fields.short_description: Client laao aur hamara 50% profit kamao. Jitne zyada referrals utni zyada income.
fields.long_description: Hamare referral program mein join karo. Koi bhi genuine client laao — property buyer, seller ya interior design client. Deal close hone par hamara 50% profit tumhara. No limit on referrals, no limit on income.

fields.title: Referral Program — 50% Profit Share
fields.description: Koi bhi genuine client laao aur hamara 50% profit kamao. Property deal, interior design ya digital marketing — kisi bhi service ke liye client laao. Deal close hone par commission seedha aapke account mein.

steps.text: Register karein hamare referral program mein
Apne network mein property/interior/marketing clients dhundein
Client ka naam aur number submit karein
Hum client se deal close karein
50% profit aapko milega — seedha aapke account mein

faq.a: Deal officially close hone ke 7 working days ke andar commission transfer ho jayega.

faq.q: Kitne clients refer kar sakte hain?
faq.a: Koi limit nahi — jitne chahein utne clients refer karein.
Haan, bilkul free hai. Koi registration fee nahi.
Abhi 50% hai. Kisi bhi change ke liye admin se contact karein.

fields.question: Property deal mein aap kya commission lete hain?
fields.answer: Hum sirf 2% commission lete hain — deal value ka. Koi hidden charges nahi.

fields.question: Interior design project kitne time mein complete hota hai?
fields.answer: Project size ke hisaab se 2-8 weeks lagte hain. Pehle 3D design approval phir execution.

fields.question: Referral commission kab milta hai?
fields.answer: Deal close hone ke 7 working days ke andar commission seedha aapke account mein transfer ho jata hai.

fields.question: Kya aap Pune ke bahar bhi properties dikhate hain?
fields.answer: Abhi hum primarily Pune aur surrounding areas mein kaam karte hain. Future mein expand karenge.

fields.question: Digital marketing ke results kitne time mein dikhte hain?
fields.answer: SEO mein 3-6 months lagte hain. Paid ads mein pehle hafte se hi results dikhne lagte hain.

fields.review: Bahut acchi service! Humari property bahut jaldi sell ho gayi. Team professional hai aur transparent bhi. Commission bhi reasonable hai.
Interior design bilkul meri expectation ke anusaar hua. Budget mein rahke bhi itna sundar kaam kar diya. Thank you Aai Bhavani team!
Referral program se mujhe bahut acchi income ho rahi hai. 3 clients diye aur teeno deals close ho gayi. Commission time pe mila.
